description: Header file defining the NinjaBinaryTargetWriter class for generating build rules for binary targets in a build system, including methods for dependency classification and build rule writing.

classes.name: NinjaBinaryTargetWriter
classes.description: Class responsible for writing Ninja build files for binary targets such as executables and libraries.

classes.name: ClassifiedDeps
classes.description: Structure used to categorize dependencies of a target into linkable, non-linkable, framework, and Swift module dependencies.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the process of writing the build rules for the target.

methods.name: GetClassifiedDeps
methods.description: Retrieves and classifies all dependencies of the target.

methods.name: ClassifyDependency
methods.description: Classifies a given dependency as linkable or non-linkable and updates the classified deps structure.

methods.name: WriteInputsStampOrPhonyAndGetDep
methods.description: Writes a phony rule for inputs and returns dependencies for the target.

methods.name: WriteCompilerBuildLine
methods.description: Writes a build line for compiling sources with specified tools and dependencies.

methods.name: WriteLinkerFlags
methods.description: Writes linker flags to the output stream.

methods.name: WritePool
methods.description: Writes pool information for build rules.

methods.name: AddSourceSetFiles
methods.description: Adds source set files to object files list.
